release_policy.rule_scope: No exact-versus-suffix publication restriction for supported domain rules. Preserve source scope as DOMAIN or DOMAIN-SUFFIX; do not add routing policy types beyond DIRECT, PROXY and REJECT.
release_policy.approval_rule: A domain is assigned only when at least two distinct configured publishers and source groups currently corroborate the same declared policy. Exact DOMAIN entries may be corroborated by exact or broader suffix evidence; DOMAIN-SUFFIX publication additionally requires at least two independent publishers to explicitly list that suffix scope. All deterministic local checks pass. Incomplete lineage and shared README references are recorded as warnings, not blanket vetoes. No AI, model API, or manual per-domain review is used.

approval_criteria.description: At least two distinct current publisher sources and source groups corroborate the same DIRECT, PROXY or REJECT policy. A DOMAIN-SUFFIX output additionally requires matching suffix-scope evidence from at least two independent publishers; source identity, policy-evidence type, entry scope and snapshot hash must match the registry.

Full-scope DIRECT/PROXY DOMAIN/DOMAIN-SUFFIX coverage, non-REJECT conditional AND/OR/NOT overlap, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, URL-REGEX, skip-proxy and protected-domain checks must pass. REJECT rules in uu.conf are excluded from automated analysis. Rule order and first-match precedence are not evaluated.

mandatory_vetoes: A fully covering explicit DIRECT/PROXY DOMAIN or DOMAIN-SUFFIX scope with a different policy blocks publication
Mixed-policy full-scope coverage is held for review without selecting a winner
Any unresolved conditional AND/OR/NOT overlap blocks publication
Any critical-function protection-list match blocks publication
Any malformed source snapshot, excessive source drift, duplicate ledger key or failed validator pauses the batch
Single-label root suffix entries are excluded; duplicate entries are deduplicated
release_policy.review_status: A single-source candidate or a candidate below the two-publisher corroboration threshold remains REVIEW; cross-policy conflicts and critical-function risks are held.
release_policy.publish_gate: No automatic writes to the user-managed modules/uu.conf. Derived rule-set outputs only.
release_policy.confidence_interpretation: Operational evidence score, not a statistical probability or guarantee of safe blocking.
release_policy.direct_proxy_policy: DIRECT and PROXY are active through the registered ACL4SSR/Clash-FX and ACL4SSR/sve1r source pairs; only domain-level corroborated entries are eligible for publication.

managed_config_guard.description: Authoritative owner-managed Shadowrocket config. Automation may read, identify, hash, diff, and register baseline metadata only after owner verification; it must never rewrite file contents, user-authored rules, or existing functionality.

last_user_approved_baseline_update.reason: Correct the stale registered baseline and register the current owner-authored modules/uu.conf blob after explicit owner authorization; the configuration content was not modified by automation.

content_protection.protected_scope: All bytes in modules/uu.conf, including user-authored rules, section contents, DNS settings, and existing code or feature behavior.

baseline_metadata_policy.update_authorization: Owner-verified registration only. Verify repository owner identity and every intervening uu.conf-changing commit before updating baseline metadata.
